description: Central Sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmers' families across the country.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal quarterly installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant or family member must be a landholding farmer
eligibility_rules.source: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

eligibility_rules.description: Must own cultivable agricultural land as per revenue records
Institutional landholders are excluded from the scheme
Persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year are excluded

required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (Patta / Chitta / Land Revenue Record)
application_method: Self-registration via PM-KISAN Portal (pmkisan.gov.in), PM-KISAN Mobile App, or through Common Service Centers (CSCs).
source_document: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines
